system.description: You may project a chosen false aura, or the appearance of no aura at all, letting you lie or mask misdeeds such as diablerie without your aura betraying you. Choosing a specific alternate aura requires prior experience with Aura Perception, though projecting no aura does not. Purchasing this power multiple times allows switching between several prepared auras; the false aura is considered always active until you consciously let your true aura show.
system.duration: Passive, ongoing (toggled to reveal true aura)
